isolation.existing_runtime_cache_use: one-time copy of non-price account/server session support from a stopped project-local non-Master Lab Portable is allowed; no existing runtime price/history cache may be copied or read for prices, and no other runtime may be executed by this family

Family 005 tensors, labels, GRU models, ONNX files, predictions, utilities, trades and outcomes

material_distinctions: one unconsumed broker-native AUDCHF external instrument rather than a US-index-only feature, target, opening body or residual basket
a completed intraday external event transfer rather than a daily or weekly context attached to existing V7/V8 lifecycles
same-local-slot causal ranks rather than an outcome-trained feature threshold or model
two frozen polar transfer responses rather than a post-outcome direction inversion
two simultaneous independent target lifecycles rather than one globally ranked target action

source_inputs.target_price_basis: MT5 rate OHLC are Bid; recorded spread times point reconstructs Ask

external_series_not_yet_acquired.price_basis: broker-native MT5 Bid OHLC; spread is retained for integrity but does not enter the signal
external_series_not_yet_acquired.acquisition_path: fresh copy_rates_range through the family-owned dedicated Portable after this declaration reaches origin/main
external_series_not_yet_acquired.receipt_requirements: pin executable, server, symbol specification, requested and returned boundaries, row count, exact columns, file bytes and SHA-256 without querying account, position, order or deal state

session_clock.dst_rule: the IANA timezone database in the Python adapter owns each local-date conversion
session_clock.new_york_hours_are_control_not_signal: the external AUDCHF pulse, not the clock, decides whether and which direction to act

external_event.completed_interval: the thirty exact AUDCHF M1 rows from decision time minus 30 minutes through decision time minus 1 minute inclusive
external_event.return: Bid close of the final interval row divided by Bid open of the first interval row minus one
external_event.positive_return_semantics: positive carry-risk impulse because AUD strengthens against CHF
external_event.negative_return_semantics: negative carry-risk impulse because AUD weakens against CHF
external_event.reference_population: the same New York local decision slot on the previous 60 chronologically complete AUDCHF sessions, excluding current date and any incomplete interval
external_event.nearest_rank: sort the 60 prior absolute returns ascending and use one-indexed position ceil(0.75*60)=45
external_event.gate: current absolute return must be nonzero and greater than or equal to the causal nearest-rank threshold
external_event.ties: all exact equality cases pass; no epsilon or randomized tie break

decision_geometry.decision_time: immediately after the external decision-minus-1 M1 bar completes
decision_geometry.target_entry_time: the exact US100 and US30 M1 row at decision time
decision_geometry.target_future_path: thirty exact target M1 rows from decision time through decision time plus 29 minutes inclusive
decision_geometry.complete_current_slot: external interval, both target entry/future timestamp paths, both causal target risk-distance histories and every required timestamp are complete
decision_geometry.normal_trading_day: New York local date with at least one structurally complete declared decision slot; zero-pulse and risk-blocked days remain in the denominator
decision_geometry.lifecycle_start_count: each accepted target symbol first fill counts once

target_risk_distance.holding_interval_range: target Bid high minus Bid low across the corresponding decision through decision-plus-29 half hour
target_risk_distance.causal_reference: the same New York local decision slot on the previous 20 chronologically complete target sessions, excluding current date
target_risk_distance.statistic: arithmetic median: mean of one-indexed sorted positions 10 and 11
target_risk_distance.risk_distance: maximum of target point 0.01 and the causal median holding-interval range

position_and_proxy_execution.long_entry: entry-row Ask reconstructed as Bid open plus entry spread times point
position_and_proxy_execution.long_stop: entry Ask minus one frozen risk distance, evaluated on Bid
position_and_proxy_execution.long_take: entry Ask plus 1.5 frozen risk distances, evaluated on Bid
position_and_proxy_execution.short_stop: entry Bid plus one frozen risk distance, evaluated on Ask
position_and_proxy_execution.short_take: entry Bid minus 1.5 frozen risk distances, evaluated on Ask
position_and_proxy_execution.same_bar_stop_and_take: adverse stop wins and exact threshold execution is used
position_and_proxy_execution.maximum_hold: thirty target M1 bars including the entry bar, then direction-specific close on decision plus 29
position_and_proxy_execution.short_time_exit: Ask close reconstructed from Bid close plus that row's recorded spread
position_and_proxy_execution.volume_rounding: floor two-percent risk-distance volume to 0.01; use minimum 0.01 only when planned loss is at most four percent of slot-start actual balance
position_and_proxy_execution.actual_execution: direction-specific Bid/Ask entry, barrier and time-exit prices
position_and_proxy_execution.extra_stress: subtract the same observed direction-specific actual spread burden once more
position_and_proxy_execution.exit_settlement_order: chronological exit time, then frozen symbol order US100 before US30 on an exact tie
position_and_proxy_execution.same_timestamp_batch_order: settle the prior batch before snapshotting balance and sizing the new batch; within a new batch size US100 then US30 from the common snapshot
position_and_proxy_execution.insolvency_or_nonfinite_balance: block later entries without rewriting already open paths

python_adapter_owns: fresh AUDCHF source and symbol-specification integrity
IANA New York local-date and decision-time conversion
exact external and target timestamp completeness
completed AUDCHF half-hour return and sixty-session same-slot nearest rank
FOLLOW or FADE direction for both targets
decision schema, sequence, freshness and bounded decision evidence
ea_must_own: adapter schema, role, sequence and freshness validation
target symbol contract, tick size, tick value, lot and market-state validation
slot-start balance risk sizing and aggregate cap
fail-closed order submission and two-target reconciliation
protective stop, take and thirty-M1 timed close
ownership, persistence, restart recovery and bounded execution evidence

development_gates.selection: highest stressed net among complete passers, then lower drawdown, then higher minimum yearly stressed net, then frozen role order

native_escalation.condition: exactly one unchanged role passes development, locked confirmation and whole proxy challenge gates
required_architecture: family-owned Python adapter and byte-pinned decision tape
native_escalation.tester_model: FPMarkets Every tick based on real ticks with 100% real ticks

ordered_stages: declaration before dedicated runtime, external acquisition, target copies, ranks, implementation or economics
fresh AUDCHF acquisition and receipt plus byte-equal target materialization
complete adapter implementation freeze with timestamp, causal-rank, direction-count and risk-feasibility structure only
locked 2026 confirmation for at most one unchanged complete passer
self-contained Python adapter plus EA compile and one native candidate path only for a complete whole-proxy survivor

stop_rules.no_development_passer: close before locked 2026, EA and MT5 without an adjacent pair, return window, reference, percentile, rank, direction, time, symbol, subgroup, risk or exit rescue
stop_rules.environment_or_engineering_fault: correct and rerun without economic verdict or arbitrary retry cap
stop_rules.success: record verified native V8 Challenge victory; Live still requires a separate user-authorized engineering and handoff decision
